required_changes: Correct the immediate request/response schema treatment. Also state that quantity_conversion and quantity_rounding are nullable: only a supplied non-null object requires conversion_factor plus operation or rounding_method plus decimal_places; a supplied null does not trigger those nested required lists.

Preserve the full product-type authority mismatch. The create request enum accepts upper- and lowercase forms of FIXED, USAGE, COMPOSITE, and SUBSCRIPTION plus client-annotated PROFESSIONAL_SERVICE and PRO_SERVICE forms, while current Get and List responses expose only the five uppercase values USAGE, SUBSCRIPTION, COMPOSITE, FIXED, and PRO_SERVICE, and the product guide documents only four product types. Add the composite-selector contradiction. The create schema descriptions call both composite_product_ids and composite_tags required for a COMPOSITE product even though neither appears in the schema required array, while the current product guide says a composite selects applicable products by ID or product tag. Preserve all three source-scoped surfaces without concluding that both arrays, either array, or one-at-least validation is the runtime rule; revise the products-and-rate-cards proposal accordingly.

Add the material SQL granularity contradiction and read-back boundary. This create raw says service_period is the default and hour is recommended, whereas the current SQL Editor authority says hour is the default and service period is opt-in; the latter also shows that the choice changes when usage cost is incurred, which rate applies, and whether a credit or commit covers the final instant. Add the SQL Editor evidence route, a reciprocal contradiction warning, and revise the billable-metrics proposal rather than inserting an unqualified service-period default into a concept that currently records hour.

Current dedicated authority creates product fields with entity contract_product, says values can be set during object creation, persist and are returned across app/API/export surfaces, and propagate from a product to its associated invoice line; the create-key enum separately exposes both product and contract_product without reconciling them, and Product Get/List annotate their returned map contract_product. Preserve the known persistence and invoice-line behavior with its timing, configured-key, propagation, and downstream limits, explicitly retain the product-versus-contract_product naming boundary, link the create-key and Get/List authorities, and revise or add fact-bearing custom-field and invoicing reciprocal proposals.
